whenToUse: FAQs, policy pages and long help text where readers scan headings and open one or two answers.
Folding meta boxes in an editor side panel or a mobile menu.
Optional advanced settings that most users never need.
avoidWhen: Content everyone must read — show it inline instead of hiding it.
Switching between peer views of the same context — use Tabs.
Marketing FAQs on a server-rendered site — use the zero-JS Faq site block.
a11y: Each trigger is a heading-level button with aria-expanded; keep trigger text short and descriptive.
Do not put interactive controls inside the trigger itself; use the header actions slot.
